body: claimed: issue-worker-high (claude-opus-5-5) · 2026-11-15T20:24Z · worktree/branch .claude/worktrees/issue-2004 issue/2004-top-z-level · plan: start the shared level law at top - stepdown, align ladder_planes, audit each depth-stepping operation, restate the affected pins and goldens

Claim released. The time budget of the worker ended before the gate was green.

Held work: branch `issue/2004-top-z-level` (commit d802f493a), draft PR #2013 (`Refs #2004`).

Done:

- The shared level law `cut_levels` starts at `top - stepdown`. The app's `ladder_planes` calls it.
- Circular vault inner rings keep their opening plane. The turning face drops a rung on the top of the work.
- The audit of all depth-stepping operations is in the PR body.
- Decisions: `docs/decisions/2004-top-z-level.md`.
- Follow-up #2012: remainder last step against equal steps.

Left:

- About 40 motion tests fail. They expect a level at Top Z. The PR body lists the count per binary.
- Read these tests with care, because they are gouge or solid laws: `blind_floor::a_blind_pocket_never_enters_solid_under_any_ladder`, `machining3d::random_ladders_never_walk_a_ring_into_hanging_or_floor_solid`, `machining3d::a_prev_mask_only_ever_removes_cuts`, `machining3d::degenerate_input_refuses_cleanly`.
- Run the motion binaries after `radial_step`, including the new `top_z_level`.
- Run the app suites. Regenerate the goldens of the changed operations (`golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens` and the other goldens). No golden is regenerated yet.
- Run clippy.

claimed: issue-worker-high (claude-opus-5-5) · 2026-11-15T20:45Z · worktree/branch .claude/worktrees/issue-2004 / issue/2004-top-z-level · plan: round 2 - read the four solid-law failures, run top_z_level, then the level-count fixtures

Round 2 result (issue-worker-high). The time budget ended. Held work is on `issue/2004-top-z-level`, head `bb06a3703`, draft PR #2013.

Done:
- The four safety tests are fixtures, not gouges. Each old pass at Top Z cut only air. The generators now refuse those cases by name. No gouge or verify check is loosened. `blind_floor`, `machining3d`, `overhang_2d` and `top_z_level` are green.
- Vault mode of Circular drops a plane at Top Z. The rim ring cut only air there.

Open (real defect, must be fixed before a merge):
- Top Z below the stock top: the first bite is now `stock top - Top Z + stepdown`, which can be more than one stepdown. The fix: the app hands the ladder the material top, and the ladder keeps the Top Z level when material stands above it.
- `one_descent` bore helix transition: verify reports `RapidInStock`. The rapid goes down to the floor of the level before. This needs a read.

Left:
- 15 motion binaries with fixture failures (list in the PR body).
- App suites, goldens, clippy.

I release the claim.
claimed: issue-worker-high (claude-opus-5-5) · 2026-11-15T21:04Z · worktree/branch .claude/worktrees/issue-2004 / issue/2004-top-z-level · plan: round 3 - material top and one_descent

Round 3 result (issue-worker-high). Head `538776d93` on `issue/2004-top-z-level`, PR #2013 (draft). The work is not complete. I release the claim.

Fixed in round 3:
1. `one_descent`, bore helix transition: a real rapid into stock. The rapid went down to Z -2 at r 6.55, and the tool disc went 0.45 mm into the core that no ring had cut (Z -2 to 0). Now a transition whose column is not open starts at the top of the cut plus the plunge height (Z 2). Verify is not changed.
2. Top Z below the stock top: `Approach::material_top` (runtime only). The app sets it from the setup stock top. `cut_levels_under` keeps the level at Top Z when stock stands over Top Z. The pocket region planes read the same top.
3. Fixtures that counted the Top Z air level: `center_cut_law`, `predrilled_entry`, `level_links`, `rotary_offset::the_seam_closes_into_a_full_ring`.

Green: `one_descent` 3/3, `top_z_level` 11/11, `center_cut_law` 6/6, `predrilled_entry` 6/6, `level_links` 12/12, `blind_floor`, `machining3d`, `overhang_2d`. Clippy on `camcraft-motion` is clean. `cargo check -p camcraft-app --tests` is clean.

Remaining:
- Red: `rotary_offset::the_height_window_names_the_stations_and_refuses_an_empty_one` (the window now refuses; the old program appears to cut only air - needs a decision).
- Red, not read: `face_blend` 1, `face_holes` 1, `entry_arc` 2, `adaptive_hsm` 1, `rotary_adaptive` 2, `machining2d` 14, `circular_arcs` 2, `corner_blend_arc_contour` 1, `corner_blend` 3, `arcs` 2.
- Trace and trochoidal slot do not read the material top yet (no `links` field there).
- Not run: app suites, goldens.

claimed: issue-worker-high (claude-opus-5-5) · 2026-11-15T21:51Z · worktree/branch .claude/worktrees/issue-2004 / issue/2004-top-z-level · plan: round 5 - trace and trochoidal slot read the material top, then the recordings and the app tests

Round 5 result on `issue/2004-top-z-level`, head `b18b928131467a963022f3efcd6bc6352fd07599` (PR #2013, draft).

- Trace, engrave and trochoidal slot now read the material top. `TraceParams` and `TrochoidParams` get `material_top`, and `generate.rs` fills it from the stock top. With Top Z under the stock top, the first level stays at Top Z. No first cut is deeper than one stepdown. Decision item 9.
- Pins: `top_z_level::a_trace_under_stock_over_top_z_keeps_the_level_at_top_z` and `top_z_level::a_trochoidal_slot_under_stock_over_top_z_keeps_the_level_at_top_z` (motion). `top_z_stock_over` (app, 2 tests, levels `[18, 15, 12]` on a stock top of 20).
- The three `vertical_arc_{x,y,oblique}.cl` recordings are regenerated. Each diff loses only the air level at Top Z. The post `vertical_arc_entry` test now counts two arc blocks (levels Z -2 and Z -4). The PR body lists the posted change.
- App: `ladder_planes_match_the_level_law_and_never_hang` and the named trace, engrave and trochoid binaries are green. Clippy on `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-post` and `camcraft-app` is clean.
- No gouge, verify, load or solid check is loosened.

Remaining:
1. Regenerate and read the goldens. `golden_cl` has 12 red tests and `solid_law_goldens` has 4 red tests. Each read diff loses the level at Top Z 0. The PR body lists them by name.
2. In `solid_law_goldens::a_lead_on_the_rings_own_circle_is_refused`, change the expected crossing list from 6 to 4 entries (the third level is gone). The refusal stays.
3. Run the full app suites that the change touches, not only the named filters.
4. Then change `Refs #2004` to `Fixes #2004` and make the PR ready for review.

I release the claim. The worktree is removed. The branch holds the work.

claimed: issue-worker-high (Opus 5.5) · 2026-11-15T22:05Z · worktree/branch .claude/worktrees/issue-2004 issue/2004-top-z-level · plan: round 6, regenerate and read the golden_cl and solid_law goldens, run the touched suites

fix on issue/2004-top-z-level · PR #2013 · pinned by top_z_level, top_z_stock_over, golden_cl, solid_law_goldens, thread_boss · merges when reviewed. Round 6: the goldens are regenerated and read. Each diff loses only the air level at Top Z and its links. The thread_boss fixture rib is now 12 mm high: a rib over the first level makes the roughing refuse. The full quick gate is not run (its plan is all app suites). The PR stays a draft.

Round 7 is on PR #2013, head `a290caadc`. The PR stays a draft.

The 12 red quick-gate tests on `185a69f1e`, by class. Class (a): the expectation names only the lost air level at Top Z. Class (b): a real regression, fixed in the code.

- (b) `blind_floor::random_stepdowns_and_floors_never_cut_below_a_floor` (app), case 4. A blind hole that is shallower than one stepdown lost its floor pass. `contour_depth::ladder` now searches the floor up to Top Z when the first level fails. New pin: `a_blind_hole_shallower_than_one_stepdown_is_cut_at_its_floor`.
- (b) `area_open::a_containment_that_puts_the_tool_in_the_part_is_refused_by_name`, `contour_outside_hole::outside_on_a_picked_hole_wall_is_refused_by_name_at_every_depth`, `contour_outside_hole::inside_on_a_picked_block_top_is_refused_by_name`. The generic empty-ladder refusal hid the #1927 named refusal. `picked_law` now runs first (`contour.rs`). The refusal text is the same.
- (a) `blind_floor` ring and through-hole tests, `contour_outside_hole` inside/auto and outer-wall tests: the level at Top Z goes. The floor and gouge asserts are the same.
- (a) `drill_prior::a_stock_facing_allowance_is_faced_and_the_drill_after_it_stands`: 4 passes, not 5. New asserts: the last pass is at the finished end, and each bite is at most one stepdown.
- (a) `post_engine::every_golden_is_a_legal_post_input`: `slot_fullwidth_centerline.cl` has 9 records. Its floor is now 8. A new assert pins its full rows at Z -3 and Z -6.
- (a) `explain_tormach`: the 9 `explain_*.nc` goldens are written again. Each loses the same lines as its plain twin.
- (a) `first_router_part`: `examples/first-router-part.camproj` is written again from the test build under `WRITE_GOLDEN=1`. The verification gate stays silent.
- `overhang_2d` (motion) is back to the main version. The weaker assert of an earlier round is removed, and the suite passes.

Readings on `a290caadc`:
- motion quick suites: ok (768 s). The run is void only because the working tree changed during it. The tests for the changed files ran again after the commit.
- motion `blind_floor` 2/2, `overhang_2d` 3/3, `top_z_level` 13/13.
- app `blind_floor` 8/8, `area_open` 11/11, `contour_outside_hole` 5/5, `drill_prior` 12/12, `first_router_part` 4/4.
- post `explain_tormach` 3/3, `post_engine` ok.
- clippy `-p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-post --all-targets -D warnings`: clean.

Not run: a full quick gate over app on the final head, and the heavy lanes.

Remaining question for the reviewer: in pocket3d, a blind hole with its floor between Top Z and the first level is refused ("nothing to machine") (motion `blind_floor::a_blind_pocket_never_enters_solid_under_any_ladder`, depth 3 at step 4). The old ladder cut only air there, so no material is lost. A floor level for pocket3d, as contour now has, is a possible follow-up. Decision item 10 has the full list.

claimed: issue-worker-high (Opus 5.5) · 2026-11-16T07:11Z · worktree/branch .claude/worktrees/issue-2004 / issue/2004-top-z-level · plan: round 8 - classify the 18 red app tests, fix each real regression, update only stale expectations, run the quick gate.

Round 8 result on `issue/2004-top-z-level` · PR #2013 · head `68b5315c8`.

**Classification of the 18 red app tests.** Each test is class (a): the test expected the old air level at Top Z. No code changed. No golden changed. No check is loosened.

- `operations` (3): the levels at Top Z go. The wrong-side contour on a bore is still refused. The test now asserts the #1927 named refusal and its side advice.
- `project_roundtrip::side_choice_round_trips_and_a_hand_edited_inside_refuses_at_generate`: still refused. The test asserts the #1927 named text.
- `predrilled_entry` (2): stock top 20 is Top Z. The plunges are `[16, 12]`. A new assert forbids a descent onto Z 20.
- `remachining` (2): the unmasked marker moves from Z 20 to Z 15. The masked asserts also forbid Z 15.
- `stitch_cross` (2): the ladder is `[0]`. The ring across two boxes is still cut at Z 0, the same as the one-block reference. The self-touching body is still refused by name.
- `turning_face_approach`, `turning_face_seed`: the pass at the stock end is air (decision item 5). The full allowance is still removed.
- `wall_arc_entry` (6): one level and one fan fewer. The second level now plunges onto Z 15. A new assert checks that each entry's last rapid ends at Z 20 or above.

**Real regressions:** none found.

**Merge fix:** main added a `TrochoidParams` literal in `crates/motion/tests/trochoid_slot.rs` without `material_top`. The motion suites did not compile. The test now sets `material_top: None`.

**Gate** (`cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`, `-j 6`, `--test-threads=6`):

- post suites: ok (129 s)
- motion suites: compile error at first; after the fix, 57 of 57 binaries ok
- motion `blind_floor` (1 fn): ok
- motion `rotary_offset` (2 fn): ok
- app suites: ok (2157 s). Slow tests: 9 tests take more than 60 s.
- clippy `-p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --tests -D warnings`: clean

The gate run is marked VOID because I edited the motion test file during the run. That file is not part of the post or app binaries. The motion step was run again on the committed head.

**Not run:** the heavy and release lanes, pixel snapshots, the GUI.

The classification table is item 11 in `docs/decisions/2004-top-z-level.md`. The PR stays a draft.

Maintainer decision, 2026-11-16 (question dialog): "Cut without #2004". The v0.22.0 cut does not wait for this issue. The release notes name it under "Known issues". PR #2013 merges after the tag and ships in the next minor.

State of PR #2013: the review of head `68b5315c8` found one blocker (https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/2013#issuecomment-6913137978). With `material_top = None`, `cut_levels_under` drops the first rest level, and four `rest_adaptive` motion tests fail. Round 9 fixes that finding on the same branch after the cut starts.
